description: tok-tua: multi-CLI agent launcher with Headroom metrics (GPU-host-preferred manager-auto).

qqq.note: QQQ modes selectable from tok-tua / Deck / OpenWebUI when wired; default local-only QQQ0

defaults._comment_lan_fallback: Optional LAN gateway host — fill in and rename keys below without the leading underscore/comment to use.

modes.gateway: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL → Headroom :8787; token metrics via Headroom/LiteLLM (official Claude Code LLM-gateway path)
modes.native: claude.ai subscription login; no Headroom metering; do not scrape OAuth usage

claude.setup: optional: your own gateway setup script for Claude Code, if you have one

notes: Clients use Headroom :8787 only; never bypass to raw worker :4000 for normal launches. Claude uses Anthropic protocol on the same front door.
